name: New Hampshire

statute.readVia: https://web.archive.org/web/20260326185526/https://gc.nh.gov/RSA/html/XXI/266/266-58-a.htm (archived copy of the official page dated 2026-03-26; gc.nh.gov answers 403 to scripts); text includes the 2024 amendment (2024, 48:1, eff. Sept. 12, 2024)

statute.cite: N.H. Rev. Stat. Ann. § 266:61-a, IX (medical permit)
statute.readVia: web.archive.org snapshot of the official page

windshield.strip: aftermarket tint on the windshield prohibited except a strip not wider than 6 in. at the very top, with light transmittance of at least 35%

frontSide.note: windows to the left and right of the driver: aftermarket tint must leave light transmittance of at least 70%

backSide.note: statute says 'rear windows' (to the rear of the driver) at least 35%; outside mirrors on both sides required

rear.note: outside rear-view mirrors required on both left and right sides when windows to the rear of the driver are tinted

windshield.strip: same as passenger: top strip max 6 in., min 35% transmittance

backSide.note: rear windows of multipurpose passenger vehicles (49 CFR 571.3) and pickup trucks may have whatever 49 CFR 571.205 allows for factory-tinted rear windows (no minimum)

tint.dualMirrors: Outside rear-view mirrors required on both left and right sides where aftermarket tint is applied to windows to the rear of the driver

medicalExemption.text: Commissioner of Safety may issue a special permit for bona fide medical reasons covering the windshield or front side windows; permitted tint min 35% light transmittance; medical certification by a NH-licensed provider or a VA-affiliated provider; a medical review board may be consulted

penalty.text: A 'violation' (non-criminal offense); also unlawful to sell or inspect a vehicle with aftermarket windshield tint

quotes: The light transmittance of after-market tinted windows to the left and right of the driver where they are allowed shall not be less than 70 percent

the light transmittance of after-market tinted rear windows where they are allowed shall not be less than 35 percent, except that the light transmittance of after market tinted rear windows of multipurpose passenger vehicles ... and pickup trucks may be such percentage as is allowed by 49 C.F.R. section 571.205
a strip not wider than 6 inches located at the very top of the windshield, provided that the light transmittance of the strip shall not be less than 35 percent
Where after market tinting is applied to windows to the rear of the driver, outside rear view mirrors shall be required on both the left and right side

helmet.conditions: riders and drivers of motorcycles or autocycles under 18

handheldPhone.noviceOrAgeBan: Under 18: no cell phone use at all, even hands-free, except to report an emergency
handheldPhone.fineText: $100 + penalty assessment first offense, $250 second, $500 subsequent within 24 months

studdedTires.season: No seasonal restriction found in RSA ch. 266 tire sections

radarDetector.note: No state ban found; commercial vehicles over 10,001 lb banned federally (49 CFR 392.71)

liftHeight.rule: RSA 266:9 'Height of Motor Vehicle Body and Chassis' exists but could not be read (official site blocked, no archive copy)

openQuestions: Official RSA site returned 403; read via Wayback
Fine for a 'violation' not read (RSA 651:2 not checked)
